def training_loss(
    model: nn.Module,
    images: torch.Tensor,
    labels: torch.Tensor,
    step: int,
    total_steps: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    progress = min(step / max(total_steps, 1), 1.0)
    dropout_decay = max(progress - 0.50, 0.0) / 0.50
    model.classifier[3].p = 0.15 * (1.0 - dropout_decay)
    logits = model(images)
    return F.cross_entropy(logits, labels, label_smoothing=0.02)
